reviewedNoSdkDeclarationRationale: Product owner reviewed the retained flow inventory and determined that codex-agent itself does not collect Apple-defined user data for the SDK developer. The documented prompt, selected workspace content, model output, and account-identifier flows are used only to perform user-requested authentication and agent functionality with OpenAI; the SDK does not use them for tracking, advertising, analytics, or developer profiling and does not expose OAuth tokens. Host applications remain responsible for reviewing their complete app and service data practices.
